$comment: Advisories intentionally ignored by .github/actions/audit-dependencies. Entry shape: { advisory: 'GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx', appliesTo: 'monorepo' | 'consumer' | 'both', rationale: string, expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }. An expired entry fails the audit so exceptions get re-reviewed; the audit also re-reviews live entries and flags any whose vulnerability a bump or relock can now clear.

entries.rationale: Reached through @sentry/nextjs > @sentry/bundler-plugins, which needs glob ^13.0.6 in every release up to 11.10.0. Sentry merged glob 14 in getsentry/sentry-javascript#26014 (issue #25969); remove this entry once a release ships it.

Reached through glob 13 under @sentry/bundler-plugins, and through ts-morph and the eslint plugins in oxlint-config, none of which has a release on minimatch 11. The Sentry fix (getsentry/sentry-javascript#26014) moves glob to 14, which needs minimatch ^11.0.2.
